proof_body:
by
  intro b n hb
  refine ⟨Nat.digits b n, ⟨fun d hd => Nat.digits_lt_base hb hd, ?_, Nat.ofDigits_digits b n⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    apply Nat.getLast_digit_ne_zero
    intro hn
    subst hn
    simp at h
  · rintro L ⟨h1, h2, rfl⟩
    exact (Nat.digits_ofDigits b hb L h1 h2).symm
target_source: ∀ (b n : ℕ), 2 ≤ b → ∃! L : List ℕ, (∀ d ∈ L, d < b) ∧ (∀ h : L ≠ [], L.getLast h ≠ 0) ∧ Nat.ofDigits b L = n
